q: The category of measure-preserving dynamical systems (X, μ, T) has morphisms given by:
opts: Measurable maps φ: X → Y such that φ∘T = S∘φ and φ_*μ = ν (factor maps)
exp: Morphisms in the ergodic theory category are measure-theoretic factor maps: measurable maps that intertwine the dynamics and push forward the measure. Isomorphisms (invertible factor maps) are the measurable conjugacies.
